statement: On every port a host opens, nothing the application serves answers without passing CoSec. A WebFlux application's management server (management.server.port different from the application's) is under the pipeline, as its application port is: its probes, and what it inherits of the application's functional routes; CoSec's own routes (the control API, the login routes) are not served there (CTL-69). A WebMvc application's management server serves only actuator's endpoints: a controller, a functional route, the control API and the login routes are not served there. A gateway's management server serves actuator's endpoints, and none of CoSec's own routes (CTL-69); the gateway's routes are served there only where Spring Cloud Gateway cannot tell the port apart (a random management port), and then under the gateway's filter. With one port, the probes are requests like any other.
